captions.summary: DESI DR1 BGS exact-selection number-count dipole mock: the mock draws from the real random density per cap (exact selection/window match), alpha and a nuisance amplitude are re-fit on every mock, and a clustering/kinematic/selection component confusion matrix shows the three are confounded (components_confounded=True). The official DESI validation mocks (1000 EZmocks + 25 AbacusSummit) are absent, so causal attribution is abandoned and only the survey-conditional pooled-rank null is reported (p=0.721). DESI-survey-conditional estimator/null diagnostic only; no dipole detection, no anisotropy, no Bianchi-family claim; the two CF4 P0s stay OPEN.
